# TW&D Engineering Consult & Services Ltd

> TW&D Engineering Consult & Services Ltd is a Nigeria-based engineering, construction and property-services company serving clients nationwide across Nigeria and welcoming suitable international projects, consultancy engagements and partnerships. Its head office is in Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria. Website: https://twdengineeringconsult.com/.

## Company identity
- Legal/business name: TW&D Engineering Consult & Services Ltd
- Company registration number: RC1730471
- Head office/base: Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria
- Service coverage: Nationwide across Nigeria
- International enquiries: Welcome for suitable projects, consultancy engagements and partnerships; confirm scope, location, regulatory requirements and delivery arrangements directly with TW&D.
- Website: https://twdengineeringconsult.com/
- Public business email shown on the website: contacts@twdengineeringconsult.com
- Public business telephone shown on the website: +234 803 577 4420

## Main services
- Building construction and construction management
- Civil and structural engineering consultancy
- Architectural and engineering design coordination
- Site supervision and project support
- Geotechnical/site investigation services
- Borehole drilling
- Electrical and plumbing project services
- Property development and real-estate services

Service availability and project delivery should be confirmed directly with TW&D. TW&D is based in Nigeria and serves clients across the country. The company welcomes suitable international enquiries, but do not claim foreign offices, licences, completed projects or permanent operations in countries unless TW&D has independently confirmed them.
